title: Assignment
subtitle: 「作業／任務」，從核心近義詞到常用學術表達。
description: 「作業／任務」，從核心近義詞到常用學術表達。

words.example: The teacher gave the class a short writing task.
words.exampleZh: 老師給全班一項短篇寫作任務。

exercises.original: The teacher gave us an assignment to compare two news articles.
exercises.zh: 老師給我們一項作業，要比較兩篇新聞文章。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher gave us a task to compare two news articles.

options.explanation: compare two news articles 是一項明確要完成的工作，task 和 assignment 高度接近。
lesson 是一節課或教學內容，不是學生要提交的工作。
原句沒有考試條件或限時測驗。
course 是整門課程，範圍遠大於單一 assignment。
notes 是筆記，並非比較文章這項指定工作。

exercises.original: Each group received a different assignment for the workshop.
exercises.zh: 每組在工作坊中收到不同任務。
exercises.upgrade: Each group received a different task for the workshop.

options.explanation: 雖然工作坊可有 activity，但句子強調每組『被指定一項要完成的工作』，task 更準確。
received a different task 完全保留 assignment 的指定任務意思。

exercises.original: The final assignment asks students to analyse a short case study.
exercises.zh: 最後作業要求學生分析一則短案例。
exercises.upgrade: The final task asks students to analyse a short case study.

options.explanation: analyse a case study 可能出現在考試，但原句只是指定作業。
asks students to analyse 明確是一項 task。

words.example: The essay is a major piece of schoolwork for this term.
words.exampleZh: 這篇文章是本學期一份重要的學校作業。

exercises.original: This essay is one of the most important assignments of the term.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章是本學期最重要的學校作業之一。
exercises.upgrade: This essay is one of the most important pieces of schoolwork of the term.

options.explanation: essay 明確是學校要求完成的一份作業。
lessons 是課堂，不是提交作品。

exercises.original: Students must keep every assignment in their portfolio.
exercises.zh: 學生必須把每份作業保存在作品集內。
exercises.upgrade: Students must keep every piece of schoolwork in their portfolio.

options.explanation: activity 太寬泛，也未必產生可放入 portfolio 的作品。
可保存於作品集的單一學生作品，語義自然。

exercises.original: The teacher displayed several strong assignments on the classroom wall.
exercises.zh: 老師把幾份優秀作業展示在課室牆上。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher displayed several strong pieces of schoolwork on the classroom wall.

options.explanation: 課堂本身不能展示在牆上。
有可能展示筆記，但原句泛指學生完成的正式作業。
several + displayed work 非常符合。
原句沒有說這些是試卷。

words.example: Students must finish the homework before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 學生必須在星期五前完成家課。

exercises.original: The teacher gave us an assignment to finish at home before Monday.
exercises.zh: 老師給我們一份星期一前在家完成的作業。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher gave us homework to finish before Monday.

options.explanation: finish at home before Monday 明確是家課。
不等於帶回家完成的工作。

exercises.original: This assignment should be completed at home and returned tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 這份作業應在家完成，明天交回。
exercises.upgrade: This homework should be completed at home and returned tomorrow.

options.explanation: classwork 通常在課堂內完成，與 at home 相反。
at home + returned tomorrow 是典型 homework。
太寬泛，沒有保留家課意思。

exercises.original: Students complained that the weekend assignment was too long.
exercises.zh: 學生投訴週末家課太長。
exercises.upgrade: Students complained that the weekend homework was too long.

options.explanation: 不是被指定完成的週末作業。
可能是其中一種，但 too long 的整體週末家課更適合 homework。
weekend assignment 通常就是週末家課。

words.example: The final exercise asks students to rewrite five sentences.
words.exampleZh: 最後一項練習要求學生改寫五個句子。

exercises.original: The assignment asks students to practise changing verbs into the past tense.
exercises.zh: 這項作業要求學生練習把動詞改成過去式。
exercises.upgrade: The exercise asks students to practise changing verbs into the past tense.

options.explanation: practise + verb forms 明確是技能練習。

exercises.original: Complete the assignment at the bottom of page 42.
exercises.zh: 完成第42頁底部的練習。
exercises.upgrade: Complete the exercise at the bottom of page 42.

options.explanation: textbook page 上的單一題組最自然叫 exercise。
除非明確是測驗，否則不宜。

exercises.original: The vocabulary assignment contains ten short practice questions.
exercises.zh: 詞彙作業包含十條短練習題。
exercises.upgrade: The vocabulary exercise contains ten short practice questions.

options.explanation: 十條短練習題不屬大型 project。
練習題不等於正式考試。

words.example: The report forms part of the assessed coursework.
words.exampleZh: 這份報告是評核課業的一部分。

exercises.original: The research report is an assignment worth 30 percent of the course grade.
exercises.zh: 研究報告是一項佔課程總成績30%的課業。
exercises.upgrade: The research report forms part of the coursework worth 30 percent of the course grade.

options.explanation: graded course work + 30 percent 很符合 coursework。

exercises.original: Students submit several assignments throughout the semester.
exercises.zh: 學生在整個學期提交多份課程作業。
exercises.upgrade: Students submit several pieces of coursework throughout the semester.

options.explanation: 可能只是其中部分，不能概括所有作業。

exercises.original: The assignment contributes to the assessed work for the course.
exercises.zh: 這份作業屬於課程評核課業的一部分。
exercises.upgrade: The assignment contributes to the assessed coursework for the course.

options.explanation: assessed work 不一定是考試。

words.example: Students will complete a group project on local history.
words.exampleZh: 學生將完成一項本地歷史小組專題作業。

exercises.original: The assignment requires groups to research a local environmental issue for six weeks.
exercises.zh: 這份作業要求小組用六星期研究一項本地環境議題。
exercises.upgrade: The project requires groups to research a local environmental issue for six weeks.

options.explanation: groups + research + six weeks 明確是長期專題。
不足以表達六星期研究。

exercises.original: For this assignment, students must design and build a model bridge.
exercises.zh: 這項作業要求學生設計並製作模型橋。
exercises.upgrade: For this project, students must design and build a model bridge.

options.explanation: 可算活動，但設計＋製作成品更像 project。

exercises.original: The final assignment involves research, a presentation and a written reflection.
exercises.zh: 期末作業包括研究、簡報和書面反思。
exercises.upgrade: The final project involves research, a presentation and a written reflection.

options.explanation: 多部分、綜合性工作典型是 project。

words.example: The final essay is due at the end of the month.
words.exampleZh: 期末文章作業月底到期。

exercises.original: The assignment asks students to argue whether school uniforms should be compulsory.
exercises.zh: 這份作業要求學生論證校服是否應該強制。
exercises.upgrade: The essay asks students to argue whether school uniforms should be compulsory.

options.explanation: argue whether 明確要求論述型文章。
不足以表達完整論證文章。
可能較廣，但這裡核心是寫論述。

exercises.original: The literature assignment should be about 1,500 words long.
exercises.zh: 文學文章作業應約1,500字。
exercises.upgrade: The literature essay should be about 1,500 words long.

options.explanation: 文學分析通常不是 report。

exercises.original: She received a high mark for her assignment on the novel.
exercises.zh: 她關於該小說的文章作業取得高分。
exercises.upgrade: She received a high mark for her essay on the novel.

options.explanation: on the novel 通常更自然是 essay。
文學作品分析＋評分最貼切。

words.example: Each student must submit a report on the experiment.
words.exampleZh: 每名學生都必須提交一份實驗報告。

exercises.original: The assignment summarises the results of the science experiment.
exercises.zh: 這份作業總結科學實驗結果。
exercises.upgrade: The report summarises the results of the science experiment.

options.explanation: summarises results of experiment 是典型 lab/report 功能。
essay 偏論述，不以實驗結果格式為核心。

exercises.original: Students must submit an assignment describing their fieldwork findings.
exercises.zh: 學生必須提交一份描述實地考察結果的報告作業。
exercises.upgrade: Students must submit a report describing their fieldwork findings.

options.explanation: 可能有分析，但 fieldwork findings 更自然搭配 report。
submit a report + findings 是高頻搭配。
fieldwork 可以是 project 一部分，但提交物本身是 report。

exercises.original: The assignment should include an introduction, methods, results and conclusion.
exercises.zh: 作業應包括引言、方法、結果和結論。
exercises.upgrade: The report should include an introduction, methods, results and conclusion.

options.explanation: 不會通常有完整 methods/results 結構。
essay 通常不用 methods/results 作標準結構。
這是典型學術／實驗 report 結構。

words.example: The teacher handed out a worksheet on fractions.
words.exampleZh: 老師派發了一張分數工作紙。

exercises.original: The assignment contains twenty short questions on fractions.
exercises.zh: 這份作業包含二十條分數短題。
exercises.upgrade: The worksheet contains twenty short questions on fractions.

options.explanation: 多條短題的紙本／文件活動典型叫 worksheet。

exercises.original: The teacher handed out the assignment at the start of class.
exercises.zh: 老師在課堂開始時派發工作紙。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher handed out the worksheet at the start of class.

options.explanation: 可指上面的活動，但 handed out 更指具體 worksheet 文件。

exercises.original: Students completed the assignment by filling in the table and answering six questions.
exercises.zh: 學生填表並回答六條問題完成工作紙。
exercises.upgrade: Students completed the worksheet by filling in the table and answering six questions.

options.explanation: fill in table + answer questions 是典型工作紙。
若沒有受控評核，不應叫 test。

words.example: The questions are classwork and should be finished before the lesson ends.
words.exampleZh: 這些問題是堂課作業，應在課堂結束前完成。

exercises.original: This assignment must be completed before the lesson ends.
exercises.zh: 這份堂課作業必須在下課前完成。
exercises.upgrade: This classwork must be completed before the lesson ends.

options.explanation: before the lesson ends 明確是課堂內工作。

exercises.original: The teacher collected the assignment at the end of the period.
exercises.zh: 老師在課堂結束時收回堂課作業。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher collected the classwork at the end of the period.

options.explanation: 通常不是同一節課結束時完成。
end of the period 是明確課堂內線索。

exercises.original: Students who finish the assignment early may begin the reading task.
exercises.zh: 提早完成堂課作業的學生可以開始閱讀任務。
exercises.upgrade: Students who finish the classwork early may begin the reading task.

options.explanation: early within class context 更像 classwork。
finish early then begin another in-class task 很自然。

words.example: All written work must be submitted electronically.
words.exampleZh: 所有書面作業都必須以電子方式提交。

exercises.original: All assignments must be submitted electronically.
exercises.zh: 所有書面作業都必須以電子方式提交。
exercises.upgrade: All written work must be submitted electronically.

options.explanation: 電子提交的多種書面作業可由此概括。

exercises.original: The teacher marks every assignment using the same rubric.
exercises.zh: 老師用同一評分準則批改每份書面作業。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher marks every piece of written work using the same rubric.

options.explanation: marks + rubric + written output 完全吻合。
不一定是正式提交作業。

exercises.original: Students should proofread the assignment before submitting it.
exercises.zh: 學生提交書面作業前應校對。
exercises.upgrade: Students should proofread the written work before submitting it.

options.explanation: 可能包含非書面部分，proofread 更明確指 written work。
proofread + submit 是典型書面作業語境。

words.example: The teacher set a short take-home task for the weekend.
words.exampleZh: 老師安排了一項週末帶回家完成的短作業。

exercises.original: The assignment should be completed at home over the weekend.
exercises.zh: 這項作業應在週末帶回家完成。
exercises.upgrade: The take-home task should be completed over the weekend.

options.explanation: completed at home over weekend 是直接線索。
除非明確 take-home exam，否則不應。

exercises.original: The teacher set a short assignment to finish after class.
exercises.zh: 老師安排了一項課後完成的短作業。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher set a short take-home task to finish after class.

options.explanation: 也自然，但 take-home task 更保留『單一指定任務』的結構。
after class + set a short task 完全吻合。

exercises.original: Students may use their notes for the assignment they complete at home.
exercises.zh: 學生可以在家完成這項作業時使用筆記。
exercises.upgrade: Students may use their notes for the take-home task.

options.explanation: 也可能，但題幹強調一項可用 notes 的特定任務。
at home + specific task 很貼切。

words.example: Each student must submit one substantial piece of work.
words.exampleZh: 每名學生必須提交一份較大型的作業。

exercises.original: Each student must submit one substantial assignment this term.
exercises.zh: 每名學生本學期必須提交一份較大型作業。
exercises.upgrade: Each student must submit one substantial piece of work this term.

options.explanation: one substantial + submit 是自然的廣義作業說法。

exercises.original: The assignment was assessed using four criteria.
exercises.zh: 這份作業按四項準則評核。
exercises.upgrade: The piece of work was assessed using four criteria.

options.explanation: 可被評估，但 assignment 作為提交成果更自然叫 piece of work。

exercises.original: This assignment shows a clear improvement over her previous one.
exercises.zh: 這份作業比她上一份明顯進步。
exercises.upgrade: This piece of work shows a clear improvement over her previous one.

options.explanation: 可自然比較兩份學生作品。

words.example: The activity is designed as an academic task rather than a casual exercise.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動被設計成正式學術任務，而非一般練習。

exercises.original: The assignment requires students to compare two academic sources.
exercises.zh: 這項學術任務要求學生比較兩個學術來源。
exercises.upgrade: The academic task requires students to compare two academic sources.

options.explanation: compare academic sources 是典型學術任務。

exercises.original: This assignment tests students' ability to evaluate evidence.
exercises.zh: 這項學術任務測試學生評估證據的能力。
exercises.upgrade: This academic task tests students' ability to evaluate evidence.

options.explanation: evaluate evidence 是明確學術技能。
句子說 task 測試能力，但不是正式 test 形式。

exercises.original: The assignment combines reading, analysis and written argument.
exercises.zh: 這項學術任務結合閱讀、分析和書面論證。
exercises.upgrade: The academic task combines reading, analysis and written argument.

options.explanation: 可包含這些元素，但原句是一般學術任務。
reading + analysis + argument 典型學術工作。

falseSynonyms.zh: 課堂不等於作業 lesson 是一節課或教學內容；assignment 是學生被要求完成的工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lesson may include an assignment, but the two are not the same thing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 考試不等於一般 assignment exam 是在受控條件下測驗知識或能力；assignment 通常是較自由完成並提交的作業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An exam assesses performance under test conditions; an assignment is usually completed over a longer period.

falseSynonyms.zh: 測驗不等於作業 test 通常是短時間評量；assignment 是指定工作，可以有研究、寫作或製作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A test measures performance; an assignment asks students to produce or complete work.

falseSynonyms.zh: 教案不等於學生作業 lesson plan 是教師的教學安排，不是學生提交的作業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A teacher prepares a lesson plan and gives students assignments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 科目不等於作業 subject 是學習領域，如 English 或 Science；assignment 是該科目中的一項工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON English is a subject; an essay may be an English assignment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 課程不等於作業 course 是一整套學習單元；assignment 是其中一項要求。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A course may contain several assignments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 筆記不等於作業 notes 是學習記錄或資料；除非老師明確要求提交筆記，否則不等於 assignment。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Notes can help with an assignment, but they are not usually the assignment itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 活動過於寬泛 activity 可以是任何課堂或學習活動；assignment 通常有明確完成要求和成果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A classroom activity may not require submission, while an assignment usually has a defined outcome.
